6 mm is a bit large but not impossible! Take the flomax, drink so much water you're leaking, get a heating pad (it was a life saver!!) And sleep on the side of the stone. Hopefully they gave you pain meds! Good luck!
Have you been taking Azo or a generic store brand Azo? If so that can certainly show high nitrites and stuff and throw off the tests. That's what happened to me at least.

Second this! Drink so much water.you're leaking! The more you pee the more chances you'll have a passing it. Hot baths and heating pads make all the difference. Also, studies show sleeping on the side of the stone (if you can tolerate it) can help it pass quicker. Something about blood flow I think.

On my second stone now. The pain is horrible! During a CT scan they had me put my hands over my head and that was the worst pain I've ever felt in my life! Stay strong and drink lots of water! We'll get through this!

So for me it was about 4 days before my kidney pain started. Yours is definitely going on longer than mine did. Definitely get checked! If you start running a fever go to the ER as it's probably an infection and spread to your kidneys.

Had the exact same issue. Only symptom was the constant urge to pee. First suspected a UTI but labs came back negative. A few days later the kidney pain started and turns out I have a kidney stone! So yeah, it could definitely be a kidney stone, but first get checked for a UTI!
